title: Beating Hateful Narratives on Social Media with Facts: Retrieval-Augmented Counter-Speech Generation
abstract: arXiv:2510.12316v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Online hate speech threatens social cohesion by amplifying discrimination and harmful narratives against marginalized communities. While counter-speech (CS) - fact-based, respectful responses to hate - offers a constructive alternative to content removal, its large-scale generation remains constrained by factual reliability and the risk of generic responses. We address these challenges with a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline grounded in the first large-scale, curated knowledge base built from authoritative international and regional human rights sources, including the United Nations Digital Library, EUR-Lex, and the EU Agency for Fundamental Rights. The framework covers eight groups frequently targeted by online abuse. translated_title: 用事实击败社交媒体上的仇恨叙事：检索增强的反仇恨言语生成
translated_abstract: 网络仇恨言论通过放大针对边缘化群体的歧视和有害叙事，威胁着社会凝聚力。反仇恨言语——即基于事实、尊重他人的对仇恨言论的回应——为内容删除提供了一种建设性的替代方案，但其大规模生成仍受限于事实可靠性和回复过于笼统的风险。我们通过一个检索增强生成管线来应对这些挑战，该管线基于首个大规模、精心整理的知识库构建，该知识库源自权威的国际和区域人权资料来源，包括联合国数字图书馆、EUR-Lex和欧盟基本权利署。该框架涵盖了八个经常成为网络滥用目标的群体。我们系统地评估了管线的所有组件，结合自动指标、基于大语言模型的评判以及人工评估，并通过对比实验证明每个设计选择都具有实证依据。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个基于权威人权文献（如联合国数字图书馆、EUR-Lex等）构建的大规模知识库的检索增强生成管线，用于生成事实可靠且针对性强的反仇恨言语，以建设性地对抗社交媒体上的仇恨言论。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline grounded in the first large-scale curated knowledge base built from authoritative human rights sources (e.g., UN Digital Library, EUR-Lex), enabling the generation of factually reliable and specific counter-speech to constructively combat online hate speech.
